name: shift-card
title: Shift Card
description: A card whose bottom panel grows over the middle content on hover, focus or click, swapping what the top shows.

props.name: topRevealContent
props.description: Fades in below topContent while the card is expanded.

props.name: middleContent
props.description: Centre content that fades out while the card is expanded.

props.name: bottomContent
props.description: Bottom panel. A peek stays visible at rest and the rest opens on hover, focus or click.

props.name: collapsedHeight
props.description: Height in pixels of the bottom peek at rest.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the panel takes to open.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
